body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> LG explained its collaboration with Netflix to deliver a compelling new online home entertainment service planned for the second half of 2008.

This partnership supports the Netflix core strategy of offering a multi-dimensional service that gives its more than 7 million members a variety of ways to receive movies and TV series for one, low monthly fee. With the availability of the networked LG product planned for later this year, Netflix subscribers can watch movies streamed from the Netflix web site on their large-screen home theater HDTVs, in addition to the current capability to watch movies instantly on their PCs.
